content: समाहृ €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To bring, convey, carry; सर्व एव समाहारि तदा शैलः सहौषधिः <ls>Bk. 15. 107</ls>. .²2 To collect, bring together, convene; तत्र स्वयंवरसमाहृतराजलोकम् <ls>R. 5. 64</ls>; <ls>Bk. 8. 63</ls>. .²3 To draw, attract. .²4 To destroy, annihilate; लोकान् समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः <ls>Bg. 11. 32</ls>. .²5 To complete (as a sacrifice). .²6 To return, restore to oneʼs proper place; स दण्डं प्राप्नुयान्माषं तच्च तस्मिन् समाहरेत् <ls>Ms. 8. 319</ls>. .²7 To curb, restrain. .²8 To offer. .²9 To contract, abridge.
